name: Threshold Run
focus: Lactate threshold development, builds sustainable hard-effort capacity

steps.description: 10 min easy jog, leg swings 10 forward/back each leg, 10 bodyweight squats, dynamic stretching
8 min threshold @ 5:00–5:15/km (Z4), comfortably hard, controlled breathing
2 min easy jog recovery @ 6:30/km (Z1), catch breath fully
5 min easy jog, quad and hamstring stretches 30s each

name: Core Finisher — Shoulder-Safe
focus: Brief neuromuscular stimulus, no fatigue accumulation
notes: Quick circuit after run. 2 rounds: 10x glute bridge, 8x/side dead bug, 20s plank. 45s rest between exercises, 60s between rounds. No heavy loading or shoulder work—recovery-focused finisher.

steps.description: Hip circles, 5 glute bridges, light dynamic stretching
2 rounds: 10x glute bridge | 8x/side dead bug | 20s plank. 45s rest between exercises, 60s between rounds.
Quad and hip flexor stretch 30s each

name: Lower Body & Core Circuit
notes: 2 rounds (recovery week volume). Circuit: 10x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg dumbbells, 8x/leg TRX split squat, 15x band glute bridge, 8x/side dead bug, 30s plank. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds. No shoulder loading. Focus on controlled range of motion.

steps.description: Leg swings forward and lateral (10/leg), hip circles, 10 bodyweight squats, 10 glute bridges
2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 16kg | 10x RDL 16kg | 8x/leg TRX split squat | 15x band glute bridge | 8x/side dead bug | 30s plank. 60s rest between exercises, 90s between rounds.
Seated hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute stretch, hip flexor lunge hold—30-45s each

name: Long Easy Ride
focus: Aerobic base volume, sustained Z2 — anchor session of the week

steps.description: Easy rolling warm-up, HR building gradually — no hills, flat terrain for first 15 min
Steady Z2, HR 146-162 bpm throughout — ease off on climbs if HR exceeds 163, flat to rolling route preferred
Easy spin/flat, HR dropping below 140 bpm — stop for 3 min quad and hip flexor stretch before finishing

name: Lower Body & Core Circuit
notes: 1.5 rounds to keep Friday fresh before potential weekend sessions. Circuit: 10x goblet squat 16kg, 8x RDL 16kg dumbbells, 6x/leg TRX split squat, 12x band glute bridge, 6x/side dead bug, 20s plank. 60s rest between exercises. Focus on movement quality.

steps.description: Leg swings forward and lateral (8/leg), hip circles, 8 bodyweight squats
1.5 rounds: 10x goblet squat 16kg | 8x RDL 16kg | 6x/leg TRX split squat | 12x band glute bridge | 6x/side dead bug | 20s plank. 60s rest between exercises.
Seated hamstring stretch, figure-4 glute stretch—30s each
